mission.title: crossplane: ProviderConfigUsage does not work when deletion policy is set to Foreground
mission.description: ProviderConfigUsage does not work when deletion policy is set to Foreground. This issue affects 20+ users.

steps.title: Identify crossplane troubleshoot symptoms
steps.description:
Check for the issue in your crossplane deployment:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n crossplane -l app.kubernetes.io/name=crossplane
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=crossplane -n crossplane --tail=100 | grep -i error
```
Look for errors or warnings in the logs that may indicate the issue.

steps.title: Review crossplane configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant crossplane configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n crossplane -l app.kubernetes.io/name=crossplane
kubectl get configmap -n crossplane -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=crossplane
```

steps.description:
Just my two cents, It also happens to me as well when working in the following scenario:
We are creating a composition for `Azure` that creates a dynamic provider config (so each team uses its own credentials) and then creating the rest of the components (i.e, a ResourceGroup).

steps.title: Confirm ProviderConfigUsage does not work when deletion… is resolved
steps.description:
Verify the fix by checking that the original error no longer occurs:
```bash
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=crossplane -n crossplane --tail=50 --since=5m
kubectl get events -n crossplane --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm that the issue symptoms are gone.
